name: camera-scan-gate
title: Camera Scan Gate
description: Camera scan gate for vertical reels: a viewfinder sweeps once, its four corner brackets tighten onto the target, then a pulse, check flash and a Montserrat confirmation chip lock it in. Scan line, brackets and glow ride the reel's brand red; the label and sweep speed are fields. Sized for the 780 px graphics field.

variables.label: Target label
variables.description: Confirmation label revealed at recognition lock. Blank hides the line.

variables.label: Sweep speed
variables.description: Speed multiplier for the scan sweep phase only.
